T: Back to the island. Bring snacks.
D: A team heads to a remote equatorial island to collect dinosaur DNA and picks up a stranded family on the way.
P: Serve the snacks when the team reaches the island.
S: Dolores, the little aquilops Isabella keeps

Pineapple, mango, papaya and passionfruit cut and piled on banana leaves, with lime and chilli salt. Lay banana leaves on a big platter. Cut a pineapple, 2 mangoes and half a papaya into wedges and pile on top with halved passionfruit. Squeeze over lime juice and sprinkle with a little salt mixed with chilli.
Delgado sailboat fish bites and lime mayo

Chunks of flathead in crunchy panko, shallow fried golden and served in paper with a zesty lime and chilli mayo for dipping. Cut 500g flathead fillets into bite-size chunks and season. Dust in 50g plain flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and coat in 120g panko. Shallow fry in 1cm oil at 180C for 2 minutes a side until golden. Drain on paper towel. Mix 150g mayo with the zest and juice of 1 lime and 1 tsp sriracha. Serve the fish in paper cones with the mayo and lime wedges.
Prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime butter, piled on a platter with lime wedges.
M: the drug company paying for the whole trip

Snapper fillets rubbed with lime and chilli, grilled in banana leaves for 10 minutes, with coconut rice. Rub 4 snapper fillets with lime juice, chopped red chilli and salt. Wrap each in a softened banana leaf and grill for 10 minutes. Cook jasmine rice in coconut milk with a pinch of salt. Serve the fish in its leaf on the rice.
the abandoned research facility on the island

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder. Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours. Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake at 200C for 20 minutes for cornbread.
W: the clifftop nest where they take a sample

Dark chocolate mousse set in glasses for 3 hours, topped with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and a speckled chocolate egg. Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whip 300ml cream and whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks. Stir yolks into the chocolate, then fold in cream and whites. Spoon into glasses and chill 3 hours. Top with crushed chocolate biscuits and a speckled egg.
K: Coconut water, pineapple juice and lime with mint over ice.

Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile onto a platter with lime wedges and pour over the butter from the pan.

d.how: Fill tall glasses with ice and a few mint leaves. Pour in equal parts coconut water and pineapple juice, then squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir and serve cold, like a drink on a boat heading somewhere it should not.
